anna (eng-platform): quick proposal — let's expose a compact, stable failure header so clients can surface consistent messaging during rollouts. e.g. `X-RW-Failure-Class: transient|quota|capacity|permanent`
ben (eng-runtime): love the idea. how does this map to HTTP? 429 vs 5xx vs a new code?
carla (prod-ux): from a ux perspective we need one canonical phrase for each class to show in the console and in SDK errors. short, actionable copy.
dave (eng-infra): telemetry side: please keep values low-cardinality enums. we should also emit `route_decision` and `cost_tier` in traces, not the full model name.
anna (eng-platform): thinking headers bundle: `X-RW-Failure-Class`, `X-RW-Subcode`, `X-RW-Client-Hint`. Client hint carries a tiny structured suggestion like `retry-after=5;reduce_batch=true` so SDKs can auto-surface tips.
ben (eng-runtime): don't invent new status codes — use 429 for client-rate, 503 for capacity, but include `X-RW-Subcode` to disambiguate `quota_soft|quota_hard|burst_block`. avoids breaking proxies.
carla (prod-ux): example UX text mapping (for docs/console):
- quota_soft -> "You're hitting a soft quota. Try reducing concurrency or request size; operation will succeed if you back off."
- quota_hard -> "Quota exceeded. Contact account team or purchase reserved capacity."
- capacity -> "Transient capacity pressure. System will retry; consider reducing batch size for lower latency."
- permanent -> "Request won't succeed (invalid request). See docs."
anna (eng-platform): snippet for header examples:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RW-Failure-Class: quota
X-RW-Subcode: quota_soft
X-RW-Client-Hint: retry-after=6;recommendation=reduce_batch
```

dave (eng-infra): telemetry: add `failure_class` and `subcode` as indexed tags for aggregated dashboards, but sample the full `client_hint` freeform to avoid high cardinality. also cap unique `subcode` values in code to avoid drift.
ben (eng-runtime): for SDKs: map `subcode` -> severity levels (info/warn/error) and show one-line suggested action. keep the header parsing tolerant (older SDKs ignore unknown fields).
carla (prod-ux): console rollout UX idea: allow tenant admins to preview the exact message customers will see, and a toggle to opt into showing the client hint header (opt-out by default for enterprise until docs + legal check).
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for `client-visible-hint-headers` on 10% of hosts — watch `failure_class` tag in the infra dashboard. :rocket:
anna (eng-platform): open questions: authorization leakage? header content safe for logs? we should sanitize any freeform text. i'll put an RFC with mapping, migration plan, and removal window for old subcodes. reviewers: @ben @carla @dave
ben (eng-runtime): ack, will review. also propose a small SDK patch to surface hint parsing without changing public method signatures.
carla (prod-ux): i'll draft the console preview UI copy and add examples for docs.
dave (eng-infra): i'll add aggregated widgets: stacked `failure_class` by tenant and a tooltip that shows `subcode` breakdown and recommended actions. sample-only the verbose client_hint.
anna (eng-platform): thanks — i'll open the PR and link the canary dashboard. small follow-up: let's decide on exact enum names in the RFC so dashboards + SDKs can be stable. :+1:
